name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2460: The console has published every ledger it can build since v2329 and the worker receiving those masks stored exactly one of them, so a uniques mask would have been discarded on arrival and the uniques cross-reference could never have worked end to end. Grok measured the board side and I confirmed it from the live record and both of us were looking at the wrong end. The worker now iterates a declared allow-list, and the reason a ledger was omitted is stored instead of vanishing.
